CYGNET — credits and licences
=============================

This is a prototype build. Every third-party asset in it is listed here,
and the attributions below travel with the build wherever it goes.


ENVIRONMENT ART
---------------

Stylized Nature MegaKit by Quaternius — CC0 1.0 (public domain).
https://quaternius.com/
No attribution is required; it is given anyway.

by wisdom3D (https://sketchfab.com/wisdom3D)
licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

This work is based on "Swan"
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/swan-56291f4202ba4d6f8755e71109107651)

This work is based on "Mouse Low Poly"
(https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/mouse-low-poly-2f34c0d825e84b289880b21754b9ce36)

AUDIO
-----

Water splashes: "Waboba Moon Ball Water Splashes" by qubodup, Freesound
pack 46186 — CC0 1.0, confirmed from the pack's own licence file.

Music and voices, from Freesound — LICENCES NOT YET CONFIRMED:
  "Distant Sad Piano"   by patricklieberkind  freesound.org/s/216669/
  "Peaceful Simple Piano" by theojt           freesound.org/s/510949/
  "Generic Duck Quack"  by mastersoundboy2005 freesound.org/s/754978/
  "Mouse Squeaks"       by shyguy014          freesound.org/s/463789/

These four were downloaded without their licence text. Freesound sounds
carry a mix of CC0, CC BY 4.0, CC BY-NC and Sampling Plus. Until each one
is checked, this build is for private playtesting only — do not put it on
a storefront, a public download page, or anywhere it could be sold.

Sound effects generated for this project (pecks, shell break, pickup,
wingbeats, hawk pass, growth swell) are original.


ENGINE
------

Made with Godot Engine 4.7.2 — MIT licence. https://godotengine.org
